column3: malachite_ore|cube|Malachite ore: exactly the same sage-grey stone base as the attached stone tile (#4e5250 #707570 #8fa097 #9daea4 #b3c3bb), with 4-5 rounded crusts of malachite, each 5-8 px, a deep green copper mineral showing banded rings of dark and light green (#1d5a3c #2a7a50 #3f9a66 #6cc08c #a6e0bc), the darkest green in the crevice round each crust, light from the top left
column4: native_copper|cube|Native copper as a block tile for small lump boxes: knobbly metallic copper, dull reddish-orange (#6a3016 #8f4422 #b0602f #cf7c45 #e8a272), lumpy rounded bulges 4-7 px each with a small soft highlight on the upper left of each, dark brown tarnish (#4a2412) in the creases, three or four small specks of green patina (#4f8a62 #6aa57a), seamless
column5: bellows_side|face|Side of a pair of hand bellows lying flat, for a box 20 px tall: the TOP 12 ROWS are plain oak board (#4d4035 #6c5c42 #7e694e) and are hidden; rows 12-15 the upper oak board edge (#6c5c42 #957e59 light top edge), rows 16-27 the pleated leather bag between the boards, 3 horizontal folds of brown leather (#5a3420 #7a4a2c #9a6440 #b07a50), each fold lit on its upper half and dark in its crease, rows 28-31 the lower oak board (#4d4035 #6c5c42), a few dark iron nail heads (#3a3a40) along the boards
column6: bellows_top|face|Top of a pair of hand bellows seen from above: one oak board (#4d4035 #6c5c42 #7e694e #957e59) in 3 boards' grain running left to right, a round leather valve flap in the middle (#7a4a2c #9a6440) held by four iron nails (#3a3a40 #6a6a72), a 2 px darker oak rim round the edge, light from the top left

column3: mould_side|cube|Fired clay mould's side, for a box 12 px tall: fired terracotta clay (#7a3e24 #97522f #b0663c #c47a4c #d49464), smooth with faint fingerprint smudges and two or three tiny pale grit specks, a darker band along the very bottom row, seamless left to right
column4: mould_blank_top@-|face|Top of a fired clay casting mould seen from straight above: a square slab of fired terracotta clay (#7a3e24 #97522f #b0663c #c47a4c #d49464), a raised 3 px rim all round the edge lit on its top and left inner bevel, inside the rim a flat smooth floor of the same clay a step darker (#8a4a2b #9f5834), plain and empty (a head-shaped hollow is cut into it later), light from the top left
